metadata.description: Consort: a Spec-First Branched-Database TDD agent framework, running on paired Lakebase branches with human-in-the-loop gates.

plugins.name: consort
plugins.description: Consort on GitHub Copilot: the coordinator skill + role agents that drive the Spec-First Branched-Database TDD workflow (plan -> design -> build -> deploy) through the deterministic consort-drive orchestrator, with human-in-the-loop gates. Create a project with `lakebase-create-project --executor copilot`, then run the coordinator.
